_comment: Combat areas (open fighting) and slayer areas. 'monsters' lists the spawn pool.

farmlands.name: Hearthfall Fields
farmlands.flavour: Reclaimed farmland on Emberreach's doorstep. Windfalls and long grass hide the settlement's first real threats.

golbin_village.name: Cinderkin Warrens
golbin_village.flavour: Tunnels of packed ash and scrap iron, dug by the Cinderkin who took this valley while it burned.

graveyard.name: Ashen Barrows
graveyard.flavour: Stone cairns sink into grey soil. The names cut into them have been worn smooth by the ashfall.

sandy_shores.name: Sunken Strand
sandy_shores.flavour: The tide comes in over a drowned road. Whatever walked it still does.

wet_forest.name: Reedwrack Marsh
wet_forest.flavour: Flooded woodland, thigh-deep and loud at night. Lost shrines keep their foundations here.

bandit_hideout.name: Rook's Hollow
bandit_hideout.flavour: A terraced camp under a broken viaduct, held by the Sable Rooks who tax the only road inland.

icy_hills.name: Frostbound Reach
icy_hills.flavour: Wind-scoured ridges above the treeline. An observatory of black glass sits at the summit.

greyharrow_quarry.name: Greyharrow Quarry
greyharrow_quarry.flavour: A cut into the ridge that never closed. The stone it emptied still moves after dark.

castle_of_kings.name: Sunderhold Keep
castle_of_kings.flavour: The frontier's old seat of power, split down the middle by something that came out of the ground.

dragon_valley.name: Ashwyrm Hollow
dragon_valley.flavour: A caldera of warm grey slopes where the old wyrms nest in the cooling rock.

spider_slayer_area.name: Broodweb Fen
spider_slayer_area.flavour: Immigration order territory. Every reed is strung. Something is farming the fen.

abyssal_depths.name: The Umbral Deep
abyssal_depths.flavour: The dark under the frontier. It is not empty, and it is not patient.

abyssal_rift.name: Riftmouth
abyssal_rift.flavour: A wound in the rock that breathes. The most dangerous place anyone has mapped.
